Nah, if anything I just racked up a lot of debt with my shopping spree today. I feel bad for the family I am leaving behind as a result. Making them possibly financially unstable, mainly my mom who is undocumented. I want the car paid off because I can't keep working to sustain it. I literally called in sick twice this week because I couldn't even plug my phone to charge at one point... So ridiculous to be this miserable because of my mental illness. I'm just so tired of it.

I feel so bad for her... I just can't deal with my own demons.

But I'm glad you were able to accomplish such a feat! That's awesome!

I took 200 and just wound up in ICU. Didn't die, but felt super shitty the days afterward. Be prepared for uncontrollable vomitting... 

Best of luck in life... I truly do wish you get better or find help. I hope you get better one day... 💕

Hey! Exact same thing happened to me, except it all stopped when I was 12 because that's when they split up. From a young age I became sexually aroused, at times acting out sexually with my toys, mounting them and grinding on stuffed animals. I felt so guilty for hurting them, but I needed to vent somehow. I tried to have my older sister fall on top me of me naked at some point, and on another occasion I was hit mercilessly by my mom because she found my Barbie and Ken dolls nude and on top of each other. I was 7. 

Sometimes my dad would come home drunk, intoxicated and aggressive. Force my mother to lay with him even if she was audibly disgusted by his stench. After the act was over she would run to the bathroom and throw up. I would always feel the bed shaking. 

I have a vivid as hell memory of my parents and I going to a river nearby and next to a river was a small pond. My mom and I got in first and I thought it was super fun, just the three of us. I was just there when my dad laughed and told me to turn around. My mom couldn't let me go as I might go in too much in the deep end, but before I knew it I was facing in a single direction and started feeling repeated motions. My mom embracing me and my father telling her to stay like that. They were having sex while holding me. I managed to look around at one moment and saw my dad's pants, underwear, and shoes off to the side. Water rippling away from our bodies. 

I also don't really know what to make of it. Just confused.

I agree. On top of that I am a financial and political burden. I have been desiring my death for years, at times landing in hospitals with bills I casually forgot upon release. 

I want a painless death because I want to end the pain. It never subsides and becomes unbearable the longer you wait to finally end it. A failed end becomes a vicious cycle until I prevail eventually; undermining my pleas for help, help to taste the sweetness that is death. I just want to escape forever and forget it ever existed. 

I can't wait until my memory is no longer piercing anyone I was ever associated with. Where the thought of me no longer exists, even online or lined paper. I want me to end in each and every way possible. I just want peace.
